ownership.quote: I'm building Kedge, a globally distributed platform for stateful serverless apps.

stage.quote: I'm building Kedge... I've just started collecting public feedback... There's no billing yet, so the pricing page is an estimate.
stage.note: No funding, investor, accelerator, or incorporation info found anywhere. Kedge appears to be a solo project by wgjordan (ex-Fly.io engineer of 4 years, per his own Show HN post) in public preview as of 2026-07-29, with no paid billing live yet. Could not confirm bootstrapped vs. pre-seed/seed with any source, so left as unknown rather than guessing.

note: Kedge is a public-preview cloud app/sandbox platform built and posted about solely by wgjordan (GitHub: wjordan), who says he 'helped build Fly.io for 4 years' before starting Kedge. No company name distinct from the product, no funding announcements, no accelerator affiliation, and no revenue disclosure were found; treat all financial fields as unknown rather than assumed bootstrapped, since a one-person Show HN post is not sufficient confirmation of funding status.
